en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5. It was narrated to me by al-Hussain b. Ahmad from his father from Muhammad b. Ahmad from Muhammad b. al-Hussain from al-Hassan b. Ali b. Fadhal from Muhammad b. al-Hussain b. Katheer from Harun b. Kharija who said:
“One who does Ziyarat of Imam Husain (a.s.) knowing his right, the Almighty Allah forgives all his past and future sins.”
